tied_up_not_burned.locked_output_min_utxo_note: smallest amount the hash-locked output may hold; it is part of the swapped amount and goes to the claimer (or back to the locker), so it sets a minimum swap size rather than an extra cost
tied_up_not_burned.claim_collateral_note: an ADA-only UTxO of the fee payer is named as collateral; it is not spent unless the script fails on chain

emulator_checks_at_submit: vkey witness signatures (Ed25519 over the body hash) - shown by the three rejected witnesses in plain_key.rejected_witnesses
every spent key address and every required signer has a vkey witness; no extraneous witnesses
inputs exist and are unspent; validity interval against the emulator slot
a script input has a script (witness or reference) and a redeemer; collateral present, ADA-only, >= collateral_percent of the fee
emulator_does_not_check_at_submit: Plutus script execution and the script-data hash (see emulator_probe: a claim with a wrong secret swapped in after signing was accepted)
that the fee covers the minimum fee, value conservation, min-UTxO of ordinary outputs, max tx size, ex-unit limits
checked_by_this_script_instead: script validity and ex-units: lucid's local evaluator (Aiken uplc, WASM) when the transaction is built, and for every script transaction the same signed bytes were evaluated by a real cardano-node (Ogmios evaluateTransaction via Koios preprod, emulator UTxOs passed as additionalUtxo); see real_node_ex_units on each transaction
fee >= recomputed minimum fee (size, constant, ex-unit prices, reference-script bytes), value conservation, min-UTxO of every output, size and ex-unit limits; see checks on each transaction
not_verified: no transaction was submitted to a real network; phase-1 ledger rules as a node applies them (fee, reference-script fee tiering, script-data hash, collateral) are recomputed here, not enforced by a node
the real-node cross-check ran on preprod, whose Plutus cost models were compared with mainnet's and found identical; prices and fees were taken from mainnet parameters
